Description
1 oz Silver American Eagle coins from United States Mints are one of the favorites among investors and coin collectors. The first Silver American Eagle Coin was released on November 24, 1986, by United States mints for the American Eagle bullion program. American silver coin has high demand among collectors.
The 1 oz American Eagle Coin contains 1 troy ounce of .999 fine silver and is considered one of the purest silver coins produced by United States Mints. United States Government guarantees weight and purity. The American eagle is the official bullion coin of the United States. The coin has a face value of $1 and is used as legal tender.
Design Of 1 oz Silver American Eagle $1 Colorized Coin
The design of the 1 oz Silver American Eagle $1 Colorized Coin can vary depending on the coin’s year but typically features the same iconic imagery.
The coin’s obverse features the “Walking Liberty” design created by Adolph A. Weinman. This design depicts Liberty walking towards the sun with an American flag around her shoulders. The engraving”LIBERTY,” “IN GOD WE TRUST,” and the coin’s date are also included on the obverse.
The reverse (back) of the coin features the “Heraldic Eagle” design created by John Mercanti. This design features a bald eagle behind a shield and thirteen five-pointed stars above the eagle. The engraving “UNITED STATES OF AMERICA,” “1 OZ. FINE SILVER,” and “ONE DOLLAR” are also included on the reverse.
The colorized coin might have a different design than the regular one, and the colorizing might have been added to the obverse or reverse.
Main Highlights of 1 oz colorized Silver American Eagle coins.
The 1 oz American silver eagle coins greatly benefit investors and collectors. Following are the main highlights of the American eagle silver coins:
1 oz of 99.9% pure silver
Colorized design featuring an American eagle
Officially licensed by the United States Mint
Legal tender with a face value of $1
Eligible for precious metals IRA
Limited mintage, making them collectible
The obverse features Adolph A. Weinman’s classic Walking Liberty design
The reverse features John Mercanti’s depiction of a heraldic eagle
Each coin comes in a protective capsule or a display case
Product Specification: Silver American Eagle $1 Colorized Coin
The 1 oz colorized Silver American Eagle coin is popular among collectors and investors. These coins are produced by the United States Mint and feature a colorized design on the reverse side. The coin’s obverse side features the iconic Walking Liberty design, while the reverse side depicts a heraldic eagle. These coins are made of 99.9% pure silver and have a face value of $1. Additionally, the colorized version of this coin adds an extra layer of uniqueness and collectibility. Following are some specification of the American eagle 1 oz coins:
